purpose: Canonical payload schema consumed by the FUTURE Generic Visual Battle Runner. Design-only in this pack. No runtime activation.

battle_instance_id.description: Server-issued identifier. The runner is forbidden from generating this client-side in authoritative modes.

runner_mode.description: Top-level operational mode of the runner. Only live_commit_pending_future allows a downstream commit, and only via the future mode service (never the runner itself).

mode_id.description: Game mode that produced/owns the battle instance.

source_entrypoint.description: Logical entrypoint string from battle_entrypoint_registry_v5 (e.g. story_stage_battle, direct_visual_combat_route, guild_war).

viewer_kind.description: Viewer perspective. Mirrors runner_mode in this version; reserved for future split.

team_snapshot.description: Frozen hero team data at battle_instance creation time. Read-only for the runner.

enemy_snapshot.description: Frozen enemy/wave/boss data at battle_instance creation time. Read-only for the runner.

battle_background_context.description: Visual/audio context: background art id, music id, weather, lighting, faction theme.

oneOf.description: Deterministic seed; runner-side simulation forbidden in authoritative modes.
Server-issued precomputed log. Runner replays it as-is.

playback_timeline.description: Ordered timeline of turn events, animations, hit triggers and camera cues.

result_summary.description: Server-issued summary (winner, mvp, stars, duration). Display-only inside runner.

reward_policy.description: How rewards are eventually issued. Always external to the runner.

exp_policy.description: How EXP is eventually issued. Always external to the runner.

progress_policy.description: How story/daily/quest/achievement progress is eventually advanced. Always external.

result_commit_policy.description: Commit policy. Runner emits a result-ready signal; commit is server-side and idempotent.

replay_snapshot_policy.description: How a battle snapshot is captured for replay/view. View-only; never re-runs the battle.

ui_policy.description: UI affordances: skip/auto/speed/HUD/spectator-only flags. Sandbox and replay modes hide commit buttons.

privacy_policy.description: PII redaction rules (other-player snapshots in PvP/guild_war_view, etc.).

expires_at.description: Hard TTL. Expired payloads are refused by the runner.
